findings.case: A rep tick stays audible past the 30ms gate while cue PCM is delayed or silent; the old shared meter called onAudio before any cue sound.

findings.fix: Per-playback analyser upstream of the shared gain receives cue buffers only; both render and countdown read it and disconnect it.

findings.fix: Rest mention checks reuse restSpeech(decision, empty fixed line); fallback went_well is credited only when actually selected.

findings.case: An injury answer has correct injury slots but says Have a great day instead of asking the supplied dumbbell question; old behavior passed.
findings.fix: Require the supplied onboarding/session-start next question or a matching interrogative intent with its choices. Equipment availability is distinct from weight amount. Exact, paraphrased, unrelated, empty and missing-choice cases covered.
